script: A fourteen year old farm boy once invented television, and a giant company tried to steal his patent.
search_terms: a teenage boy sketching an invention on a chalkboard, vintage Americana documentary style
title: A Teenage Farm Boy Invented Television in 1927
description:
Philo Farnsworth sketched the idea for electronic television at 14 and built a working model by 21. RCA tried to steal the patent. He won in court.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
